scenes.title: The Wonder of You
narration: Have you ever wondered how you run, jump, and play all day long?
Your body is like a super machine made of many special parts.
Let us explore what your body can do!

scenes.title: Parts We Use
narration: We use our eyes to see the bright sun and colorful flowers.
Our ears help us hear the chirping birds in the park.
We use our nose to smell delicious hot rotis at home.
Our hands help us hold a pencil or eat tasty snacks.

scenes.title: Working Together
narration: Let us see how these parts work to eat a mango.
First, your eyes see the yellow mango on the table.
Next, your hands pick it up to take a bite.
Finally, your mouth tastes how sweet and yummy it is!

scenes.title: Keep Your Body Healthy
narration: Every part of your body is important and works together.
Eat healthy food and stay clean to keep them strong.
Think about it: which body part helps you give your friend a big hug?

Myself and Family: My Name, Age and Birt.topic: Myself and Family: My Name, Age and Birthday
Myself and Family: My Name, Age and Birt.title: Who Are You Today?

scenes.title: Meeting A New Friend
narration: Hello! Do you know how to tell people who you are?
We all have a special name that our family gave us.
My name is Rohan. What is your name?

scenes.title: How Old Are You
narration: Every year, we grow a little bit taller and stronger.
We count our years to know how old we are.
I am six years old. How many candles are on your cake?

scenes.title: Your Special Day
narration: Do you know the date you were born on?
That is your birthday, the best day of the year!
My birthday is in May. When is your birthday?

scenes.title: Remembering Your Details
narration: You have a name, an age, and a birthday.
These things make you very special and unique.
Think about it: Can you say your name, age, and birthday out loud?

scenes.title: Who Is In Your Family
narration: Do you know who lives in your house with you?
A family is a group of people who love and care for each other.
Some families are small, and some families are very big!

scenes.title: Meet The Family Members
narration: Your father and mother are your parents.
Your brothers and sisters are your siblings.
Grandparents are your parents' mother and father.
Uncles and aunts are also part of our family tree.

scenes.title: A Day With Family
narration: Imagine it is Sunday morning at home in Delhi.
Grandpa reads the newspaper while you play with your sister.
Mom and Dad cook a yummy breakfast together.

scenes.title: Why Families Are Special
narration: Families help us learn, play, and grow every single day.
We share chores and keep our home happy.
Can you name three people who live in your house today?

scenes.title: The Morning Routine Hook
narration: Do you ever wonder why we brush our teeth every single morning?
Good habits help our bodies stay strong and happy all day long.
Let us learn how simple habits keep us feeling great.

scenes.title: Learning Good Habits
narration: First, we wash our hands with soap before every meal.
This keeps tiny germs away so we do not get sick.
Next, we eat fresh fruits and vegetables to grow tall.
Drinking plenty of clean water is very important for us too.

scenes.title: A Day With Rohan
narration: Rohan wakes up and tidies his bed to start his day.
He helps his mother set the table for breakfast in the kitchen.
After playing outside, Rohan always puts his toys back in the box.
At night, he brushes his teeth again before going to sleep.

scenes.title: Recap and Reflect
narration: Good habits like washing hands and tidying up keep us healthy.
Helping family members makes our home a happy place to be.
What is one good habit you can start doing today?

scenes.title: Where do wild animals live?
narration: Have you seen a tiger or an elephant in your house?
No, because wild animals live freely in nature.
They find their own food and make their own homes.

scenes.title: Meeting the wild friends
narration: The Bengal Tiger is strong and loves to hunt.
An Indian Elephant is very big and eats green leaves.
Monkeys jump high and eat yummy fruit in trees.
Peacocks show off their beautiful feathers when it rains.

scenes.title: Observing the Tiger
narration: Let us look at the tiger living in a forest.
The tiger uses its stripes to hide in tall grass.
It drinks water from a cool forest stream.

scenes.title: Remembering our wild world
narration: Wild animals need forests and water to stay safe.
We must always respect them from far away.
Think about it, which wild animal is your favorite?

scenes.title: Start Your Healthy Day
narration: Do you ever wonder why your body feels so energetic after a good night's sleep?
Taking care of ourselves helps us grow tall and play with our friends.
Let us learn how simple daily habits make us feel like superheroes.

scenes.title: Keeping Our Bodies Clean
narration: First, we must wash our hands with soap before eating our meals.
Brushing your teeth twice a day keeps those tiny cavities away.
Taking a daily bath keeps our skin clean and feeling fresh.

scenes.title: Fueling Up with Food
narration: Imagine you are eating a yummy lunch of dal, rice, and fresh vegetables.
These healthy foods give your body the strength to run and jump.
Always remember to drink plenty of clean water throughout the day.

scenes.title: Recap and Reflect
narration: Cleanliness and healthy food are the secrets to a happy body.
Resting well gives our muscles time to recover and grow.
Think about it: What is one healthy habit you will start today?

scenes.title: Meet Your Animal Neighbors
narration: Do you see animals near your home or at a farm?
Some animals live with us or on farms.
We call these special friends domestic animals.

scenes.title: How They Help Us
narration: A cow gives us healthy milk every day.
A dog helps guard our home and stays loyal.
A hen provides eggs for our yummy breakfast.

scenes.title: Caring For Our Friends
narration: Just like us, these animals need water to drink.
They also need yummy food and a cozy home.
We must be gentle and kind when we pet them.

scenes.title: Time To Remember
narration: Domestic animals live near people and help us.
Always remember to be kind to every animal.
Think about it: what is your favorite domestic animal?

scenes.title: What Makes A Bird
narration: Have you seen a sparrow in your garden chirping happily?
Birds are special animals that are covered in soft feathers.
They have two legs and two wings to help them fly.

scenes.title: How Birds Eat
narration: Birds do not have teeth like we do.
Instead, they have a hard beak to pick up food.
A parrot uses its strong beak to crack open nuts.
Different birds have beaks shaped for the food they eat.

scenes.title: Where Birds Live
narration: Birds build cozy nests to keep their eggs safe.
They use twigs, grass, and mud to make their homes.
Many birds like the crow build nests high in trees.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Remember, birds have feathers, wings, and beaks.
They live in nests and use beaks to eat.
Think about it: If you were a bird, where would you build your nest?

scenes.title: Listening to the Animal World
narration: Have you ever heard a dog bark at the park?
Animals make many different sounds to talk to their friends.
Do you know what sounds other animals make?

scenes.title: Learning the Sounds
narration: A cat says meow when it wants a treat.
A cow says moo while eating grass in a field.
A bird chirps loudly in the morning sun.
And a lion roars to show its strength.

scenes.title: Let's Practice Together
narration: Imagine you see a duck swimming in a pond.
When a duck is happy, it says quack.
Can you try to quack just like a duck?

scenes.title: Quick Animal Sound Recap
narration: Dogs bark, cats meow, and cows moo.
Every animal has its own special way to speak.
Think about it: what sound does your favorite animal make?

scenes.title: Spotting Tiny Friends
narration: Have you seen tiny creatures in your garden?
Those little crawlers are called insects.
Look closely at their small bodies today.

scenes.title: What Makes an Insect
narration: All insects have six tiny legs.
They have three main body parts.
Many insects also have beautiful wings.

scenes.title: A Busy Honey Bee
narration: Let us look at a honey bee.
It lands on a flower to drink.
It uses its six legs to hold on.

scenes.title: Recap and Explore
narration: Insects have six legs and three parts.
They are important helpers in nature.
Can you count legs on a bug today?

scenes.title: Finding Animals at Home
narration: Have you ever seen a bird flying to a tree or a squirrel running to a hole?
Just like you have a cozy house, every animal needs a special place to live.
Why do you think animals choose certain places to build their homes?

scenes.title: Why They Need Homes
narration: Animals need homes to stay safe from the hot sun and the cold rain.
Homes are also perfect places to hide from bigger, hungry animals.
Some animals even use their homes to raise their tiny babies.

scenes.title: Examples in Nature
narration: A busy bird collects little twigs to build a strong nest high in a tree.
A rabbit digs a deep burrow in the ground to sleep and stay cool.
A honeybee makes a sticky, sweet beehive to store food for the winter.

scenes.title: Recap and Thinking
narration: Animals live in homes to stay safe, warm, and protected.
From nests to burrows, every animal has a home that fits its needs.
Think about it: What kind of home would you build if you were an animal?

scenes.title: The Big Blue Ocean
narration: Have you ever visited a beach and wondered what lives deep under the waves?
The ocean is like a giant home for many special animals.
Let us dive down to meet some of these underwater friends.

scenes.title: How They Swim
narration: Fish have fins that help them swim smoothly through the water.
An octopus uses its eight wiggly arms to move and grab things.
Some animals, like crabs, have hard shells to keep them safe.
Sea creatures have bodies designed to live only in the water.

scenes.title: Meet the Sea Turtle
narration: Look at the sea turtle gliding slowly near the coral reef.
Its flippers work just like paddles to help it swim far.
The turtle breathes air, so it swims up to the surface sometimes.

scenes.title: Recap and Explore
narration: Fish have fins, octopuses have arms, and turtles have flippers.
All these animals have special ways to move and stay safe.
If you could be a sea animal, which one would you choose?

scenes.title: Why do flowers grow?
narration: Have you seen the colorful flowers in your garden?
Flowers are the beautiful parts of a plant.
Why do you think plants grow these bright flowers?

scenes.title: How flowers help plants
narration: Flowers make seeds so new plants can grow.
They use bright colors to call bees and butterflies.
Insects carry dust called pollen between flowers.
This helps the plant make fruits and seeds.

scenes.title: Example: The Marigold
narration: Let us look at a yellow marigold flower.
It opens wide to catch the warm sunlight.
A busy bee lands to drink sweet nectar.
The bee helps the marigold make tiny seeds.

scenes.title: Remembering our flowers
narration: Flowers are beautiful and help plants make seeds.
Bees and butterflies love visiting colorful petals.
Think about it: what is your favorite flower?

scenes.title: Plants In Our Garden
narration: Have you noticed the green plants in your garden or a local park?
Why do some plants grow tall while others stay very small?
Let us explore how these amazing living things grow.

scenes.title: Parts Of A Plant
narration: Plants have roots hidden deep in the soil to drink water.
The stem stands tall like a strong pillar for the plant.
Bright green leaves soak up the warm sunlight all day.
Beautiful flowers bloom to make the world look colourful.

scenes.title: A Mango Tree Example
narration: Think of a mango tree starting as a tiny little seed.
With rain and sun, it grows a thick trunk.
Soon, yummy yellow mangoes grow for us to eat.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Plants need water, soil, and sunlight to stay healthy.
Roots, stems, leaves, and flowers make up every plant.
Can you find a plant today and count its leaves?

scenes.title: Meet the Animal Babies
narration: Have you ever seen a tiny puppy playing in your park?
Animals have babies just like humans do.
Do you know what we call a baby dog?

scenes.title: Learning the Special Names
narration: A baby dog is called a puppy.
A baby cat is called a kitten.
A baby cow is called a calf.
A baby duck is called a duckling.

scenes.title: Seeing Them on the Farm
narration: Let's visit a farm in Punjab.
Look, the mama hen has fluffy chicks following her.
See the sheep? Her baby is called a lamb.

scenes.title: Quick Review
narration: Puppy, kitten, calf, and lamb are all special names.
Every baby animal has a name that matches its family.
Can you name a baby animal you saw today?

scenes.title: Finding Fruit in Nature
narration: Have you ever wondered where the yummy mangoes in our fruit bowl come from?
They grow on big, green trees outside in the garden or on a farm.
Nature works like magic to turn tiny flowers into the snacks we love.

scenes.title: How Fruits Grow
narration: First, a plant grows a pretty flower to catch the bright sunlight.
Bees visit the flower to help it get ready for the next step.
The flower petals fall off, and a tiny fruit starts to appear.
The plant feeds the fruit water and food to help it grow big.

scenes.title: Example: The Mango Journey
narration: Look at a mango tree in India during the warm summer months.
Little green mangoes grow and hide under the wide, green leaves.
Soon, they turn yellow and juicy, ready for us to pick and eat.

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: So remember, fruits start as flowers before turning into the tasty food we eat.
They need sunlight, water, and help from bees to finish their journey.
Think about it, can you find a fruit growing on a plant today?

Plants and Nature: Vegetables.title: Where Do Our Vegetables Come From?

scenes.title: Finding Vegetables in the Kitchen
narration: Have you ever wondered where the carrots in your lunchbox come from?
They do not grow in the kitchen cupboard, but in the soil!
Let us go on a journey to a vegetable garden.

scenes.title: How Vegetables Grow
narration: First, a tiny seed is planted deep in the dark soil.
The sun gives the plant light and warmth to help it wake up.
Rainwater travels through the soil to give the plant a big drink.
Soon, tiny green leaves pop up to say hello to the world.

scenes.title: From Garden to Plate
narration: A farmer in India works hard to look after the crops.
When the vegetable is big and strong, it is time to harvest.
We buy them at the market to make a healthy vegetable curry.
Eating fresh vegetables helps our bodies grow strong and healthy.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Garden Friends
narration: Vegetables need sun, water, and soil to grow into yummy food.
Farmers help bring these veggies from the garden to our home.
Think about it: which vegetable is your favorite to eat?

scenes.title: The Rainy Day Mystery
narration: Have you ever looked at a rainy day and wondered where the water comes from?
It starts with the warm sun shining down on our big oceans and rivers.
The heat turns water into tiny invisible bubbles that float way up high.

scenes.title: Building Big Clouds
narration: High in the sky, those tiny bubbles get cold and bunch together.
They join up to become big, fluffy, grey clouds that we see above.
When the cloud gets too heavy, it cannot hold the water anymore.

scenes.title: The Rain Falls Down
narration: Think of a watering can in your garden pouring water on your plants.
The water drops fall from the cloud down to the earth below.
The thirsty trees and flowers drink the cool water to help them grow.

scenes.title: Nature Keeps Going
narration: The water flows back into rivers and the cycle starts all over again.
Sun warms the water, clouds form, and then it rains down again.
Think about it, what do you like to do on a rainy day?

scenes.title: The Changing Garden
narration: Do you notice how leaves change color in the park near your house?
Sometimes it is very hot and sometimes it is cold.
Why does nature change its clothes throughout the year?

scenes.title: Understanding The Seasons
narration: Earth travels around the giant sun in a big circle.
This journey takes a whole year to finish.
As we move, different parts of Earth get more sunlight.

scenes.title: India's Beautiful Seasons
narration: In India, we have the hot summer with yummy mangoes.
Then comes the monsoon when rain helps our crops grow.
Finally, the cool winter arrives for sweaters and tea.

scenes.title: Remembering The Patterns
narration: Seasons happen because Earth moves around the sun.
They repeat every year in a special order.
Which season is your favorite and why do you like it?

scenes.title: Looking at Our Trees
narration: Have you ever sat under a big shady tree in a park?
Trees are like giant friends that live outside your house.
But why are trees so important to us?

scenes.title: How Trees Grow Big
narration: Trees start as tiny seeds in the ground.
They drink water from the soil using their roots.
Then they use sunlight to make their own food.

scenes.title: Trees Give Us Gifts
narration: Look at this mango tree in a garden.
It gives us sweet fruit to eat for lunch.
Its leaves give us fresh air to breathe.
Birds build little nests in the branches.

scenes.title: Taking Care of Trees
narration: Trees give us fruit, air, and shade.
We should always protect them and never hurt them.
If you could plant one tree today, what would it be?

scenes.title: Finding Shapes At Home
narration: Have you ever looked closely at the toys in your toy box?
Everything around us is made of special shapes.
Can you spot a circle on your breakfast plate?

scenes.title: Counting Our Colorful World
narration: Let us count the colorful marbles in this jar.
One red marble, two blue, and three yellow ones.
Numbers help us know exactly how many things we have.

scenes.title: Sorting Shapes and Colors
narration: Imagine you have five bright red square blocks.
If you add one more, you now have six red squares.
Sorting by color and shape makes counting very easy.

scenes.title: Recap and Try It
narration: We learned that shapes are everywhere and numbers help us count.
Sorting things by their color makes it fun to count.
Think about it: how many round wheels can you find on a bicycle?

Colours, Shapes and Numbers: Basic Colou.topic: Colours, Shapes and Numbers: Basic Colours
Colours, Shapes and Numbers: Basic Colou.title: The Magic of Bright Colours

scenes.title: Look Around At Colours
narration: Have you ever wondered why the world looks so bright and colorful?
Let's explore the beautiful colours we see every single day.
From the red of a rose to the blue of the sky.

scenes.title: Learning Three Main Colours
narration: Red is a warm, bright colour like a juicy apple.
Yellow is as bright and happy as a shining sun.
Blue is the cool, calm colour of the deep ocean.

scenes.title: Spotting Colours In India
narration: Look at our national flag, the Tiranga, fluttering high.
Saffron at the top stands for strength and courage.
White in the middle shows us peace and truth.
Green at the bottom shows our land is full of life.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: We learned about red, yellow, and blue today.
Colours help us name everything we see around us.
Think about it: what is your very favourite colour and why?

scenes.title: Shapes in Your Room
narration: Look around your room, what shapes can you spot today?
Everything you see is made of simple shapes put together.
Let us learn about three special shapes we see everywhere.

scenes.title: Learning Our Shapes
narration: A circle is round like a yummy roti on your plate.
A square has four sides that are all the same length.
A triangle has three pointy corners and three straight sides.

scenes.title: Shapes in Real Life
narration: Look at a wall clock, it is usually a perfect circle.
Your school book is a rectangle, like a square stretched out.
A slice of delicious cheese pizza is shaped like a triangle.

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: We learned about circles, squares, and triangles today.
Shapes help us draw, build, and understand our world.
Think about it: can you find a triangle shape outside today?

Colours, Shapes and Numbers: Ordinal Num.topic: Colours, Shapes and Numbers: Ordinal Numbers
Colours, Shapes and Numbers: Ordinal Num.title: Learning Our Ordinal Numbers

scenes.title: The Big School Race
narration: Look at these friends running in a race at the park.
Have you ever wondered who arrived first or second?
Today we learn how to name the order of things.

scenes.title: First, Second, and Third
narration: The person at the front is in first place.
The next person is in second place.
The third person is in third place.
We use these special names to show the order.

scenes.title: A Colorful Lineup
narration: Let us line up three colorful balloons.
The red balloon is first in line.
The blue balloon is second.
The green balloon is third.

scenes.title: Quick Recap
narration: Ordinal numbers tell us the position in a line.
We use first, second, and third to order things.
Think about it: who is first in your family line?

scenes.title: Welcome Home
narration: Look around your room at home.
Do you like a clean space?
Why is keeping it tidy important?

scenes.title: The Idea of Tidying
narration: A home has a special place for everything.
When items are put back, we find them easily.
A clean room is safer for everyone.

scenes.title: Example: Cleaning Up
narration: First, pick up your school bag.
Second, put your books on the shelf.
Third, place your toys in the box.
See? Now the floor is clear!

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: Everything has its own home.
Putting things away makes us happy.
What will you tidy up today?

scenes.title: Welcome to School
narration: Do you know what makes our school special?
It is a place where we learn and play together.
Look around, what do you see in your classroom?

scenes.title: Important People and Places
narration: Our teacher helps us learn new things every day.
The library is full of books for us to read.
We run and play with friends in the playground.

scenes.title: My School Day
narration: First, we reach school and hang our bags.
Next, we sit quietly and listen to the lesson.
Then, we eat our healthy lunch with friends.
Finally, we pack our bags to go home.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Day
narration: School has many rooms and helpful people.
We learn, play, and make friends here.
Can you name your favorite spot in school?

scenes.title: What is a Neighbourhood
narration: Look outside your window at home. What do you see nearby?
The houses and shops near your home are called your neighbourhood.
Do you know why we need a neighbourhood?

scenes.title: Important Places Nearby
narration: We go to a park to play with our friends.
We visit the market to buy fresh vegetables and milk.
If we feel sick, we go to see a doctor at the clinic.
When we want to learn new things, we go to school.

scenes.title: A Friendly Example
narration: Meet Rohan who lives in a busy neighbourhood in Delhi.
Rohan walks to the post office to send a letter.
Then he stops at the bank to help his mother.
He sees his friendly neighbour waving hello to him.

scenes.title: Recap and Thinking
narration: Our neighbourhood has shops, schools, and parks for us.
Being kind to our neighbours makes our area a happy place.
Think about it: What is your favourite place in your neighbourhood?

scenes.title: What is a pattern?
narration: Have you ever noticed how your school uniform has stripes?
A pattern is something that repeats in a special order.
Look around your room, what do you see that repeats?

scenes.title: Shapes and Colours
narration: Patterns use colours and shapes to make things look pretty.
See this sequence: circle, square, circle, square.
We can change the colour too, like green, red, green, red.

scenes.title: Patterns with Numbers
narration: Numbers can make patterns too, just like beads on a string.
If we have one rupee, then two rupees, what comes next?
It is one again! We just keep repeating the same numbers.

scenes.title: Recap and Try It
narration: Patterns repeat shapes, colours, or numbers in a line.
You can find patterns on your clothes, in nature, and in math.
Think about it: can you create a pattern using two toys?

scenes.title: What is a Neighborhood?
narration: Look outside your window at the houses, shops, and trees near your home.
These places make up your neighborhood, where you live and play.
Have you ever wondered why we need these different places?

scenes.title: Important Places We Visit
narration: When you are sick, you visit a doctor at the clinic.
We go to the market to buy fresh milk and vegetables.
The post office helps us send letters to our friends far away.
Police stations keep our neighborhood safe for everyone.

scenes.title: A Trip to the Park
narration: Let us visit the park near your house in Delhi.
First, you walk through the green gate.
Next, you play on the swings with your friends.
Finally, you rest on a bench under a shady tree.

scenes.title: Recap and Explore
narration: We visit many places like schools, clinics, and parks every day.
These places help us stay healthy, safe, and happy together.
Think about it: which place in your neighborhood is your favorite?

scenes.title: Who Helps Us Every Day?
narration: Have you noticed the people who make our neighborhood a better place to live?
Look around your street! Who are the friendly faces helping you today?
These people are our community helpers and they do very important jobs.

scenes.title: Meet The People Helping Us
narration: A doctor helps us when we feel sick and gives us medicine.
A teacher helps us learn to read, write, and count at school.
A police officer keeps our streets safe and helps people find their way.
A farmer works hard to grow the yummy vegetables we eat for dinner.

scenes.title: How They Work Together
narration: Imagine you are hungry. The farmer grows the rice in the field.
Then, the shopkeeper brings the rice to the market for your family.
Finally, your parents buy it with rupees to cook a delicious meal.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Our community helpers keep us healthy, safe, and well-fed every day.
We should always say thank you to these kind people.
Think about it: Who is a community helper you see near your home?

scenes.title: Watching Cars Go By
narration: Have you ever stood by the road and watched the busy cars zoom past?
Many vehicles use our roads to move people and things from place to place.
Have you wondered how all these vehicles know how to stay safe?

scenes.title: Rules of the Road
narration: Traffic lights help us stay safe with three colors: Red, Yellow, and Green.
Red means stop, so all the cars wait for the road to be clear.
Yellow means wait, and Green means it is time to go safely.

scenes.title: A Trip to School
narration: Rohan takes the school bus every morning to reach his classroom on time.
The bus driver follows the road signs to keep all the children safe.
Other people use autos, bicycles, or walk on the footpath to travel.

scenes.title: Remembering Road Safety
narration: Road transport uses buses, cars, and bikes to move us around the city.
Always follow the traffic lights and look both ways before crossing the road.
Think about it: what is your favorite way to travel to the park?

scenes.title: The Big Iron Train
narration: Have you ever seen a very long train at the station?
Trains carry many people across our big country, India.
Do you know how these trains move so fast?

scenes.title: How Trains Work
narration: Trains travel on special metal tracks.
A big engine pulls all the heavy carriages behind it.
The driver sits in the front to steer the train.

scenes.title: A Trip to Delhi
narration: Imagine we are going from Mumbai to Delhi.
We buy our tickets at the counter with rupees.
We sit in our seats and watch the trees go by.
Soon, we arrive at the platform in Delhi.

scenes.title: Trains are Great
narration: Trains are a fast way to travel long distances.
They help us visit our friends and family easily.
Think about it: where would you like to travel by train?

scenes.title: The Magic of Talking
narration: Have you ever talked to your friend who lives far away?
We use a telephone to hear their voice clearly.
It is like magic, but it is actually science!

scenes.title: How Sound Travels
narration: When you speak, your voice turns into tiny signals.
These signals travel very fast through wires or air.
The other phone turns those signals back into sound.

scenes.title: Calling Grandma in Delhi
narration: Imagine you are in Mumbai calling your Grandma in Delhi.
You press the buttons to dial her special number.
Soon, your voice reaches her phone instantly.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Lesson
narration: Telephones change our voices into fast signals.
They help us talk to anyone, anywhere, anytime.
Think about it: who would you call if you could talk to anyone today?

scenes.title: The Big Blue Question
narration: Have you ever seen a big boat floating on a river?
We use boats to cross water where there are no roads.
How do these heavy boats stay on top of the water?

scenes.title: How Boats Move
narration: Boats have special shapes that help them sit on top of water.
Some boats use oars to push the water away.
Big ships use strong engines to zoom across the sea.
The water pushes the boat up, which keeps it floating.

scenes.title: Boats in India
narration: In Kerala, people use long, thin boats called snake boats.
These boats race very fast during festivals.
We also have big ferries that carry cars and people.
These ferries help us travel between islands easily.

scenes.title: Remember and Explore
narration: Boats help us cross rivers, lakes, and the deep sea.
They move by using oars, sails, or powerful engines.
Think about it: If you built a boat, what would you carry on it?

scenes.title: The Magic Screen
narration: Have you ever wondered how your favorite cartoon appears on a tablet?
It happens because of a giant invisible web called the internet.
The internet connects computers all over the world together.

scenes.title: Sending Secret Messages
narration: When you click a video, your computer sends a tiny digital message.
This message travels through long cables hidden deep under the ocean.
The message zooms to a big computer called a server.
The server sends the video right back to your home.

scenes.title: A Real Life Example
narration: Imagine you are sending a photo of a yummy Dosa to a friend.
Your device breaks the photo into tiny pieces of light.
The pieces travel through wires at lightning speed.
Your friend's phone puts the pieces back together perfectly.

scenes.title: Time To Remember
narration: The internet is a network that connects computers everywhere.
Information travels in tiny pieces through cables under the sea.
Think about it: who is the person you want to video call today?

scenes.title: The Big Metal Bird
narration: Have you ever seen a giant bird flying high above your house?
That is not a bird, it is an airplane!
How does it travel so fast across the whole world?

scenes.title: How Planes Fly
narration: Airplanes use big engines to push themselves through the air.
They need long flat paths on the ground called runways.
The pilot sits in the front to steer the plane safely.
Wings help the plane lift up and stay in the sky.

scenes.title: Taking a Trip
narration: Imagine you are flying from Delhi to Mumbai.
You go to the airport and show your ticket.
The plane climbs high above the fluffy white clouds.
Soon, you land and arrive at your destination.

scenes.title: Summary of Air Travel
narration: Airplanes are the fastest way to travel far away.
They use engines, wings, and pilots to fly.
Think about it: Where would you fly if you had a magic plane?

scenes.title: A Special Flag
narration: Have you seen our flag flying high at school?
It is called the Tiranga because it has three colors.
Let us learn what these colors mean for India.

scenes.title: The Three Colors
narration: The top stripe is saffron for strength and courage.
The middle white stripe stands for peace and truth.
The bottom green stripe shows our land is fertile.

scenes.title: The Wheel of Peace
narration: Look at the center of the white stripe.
That is the Ashoka Chakra with twenty-four spokes.
It is blue and reminds us to always keep moving.

scenes.title: Respecting Our Flag
narration: Our flag has saffron, white, green, and a blue wheel.
We always treat our flag with great respect.
Think about it: how do you feel when you see the flag?

scenes.title: A Big Beautiful Map
narration: Have you ever looked at a map of the world?
Do you see this colorful shape that looks like a triangle?
That is our home, but do you know its special name?

scenes.title: Two Names for India
narration: Our country has two main names that we use often.
The first name is India, which is used all over the world.
The second name is Bharat, which is a very old and respected name.
Both names mean the same wonderful land where we live.

scenes.title: Proud to be Indian
narration: Think of our national flag flying high in the sky.
People from Kashmir to Kanyakumari call this land home.
We all say with pride, I am an Indian.

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: So remember, our country is called India and also Bharat.
It is a big, beautiful place for all of us.
Think about it, what do you love most about living in our country?

scenes.title: A Flash of Blue
narration: Have you ever seen a bird with long, colourful tail feathers in a garden?
That is the peacock, a bird that loves to dance when it rains.
Did you know the peacock is the special national bird of India?

scenes.title: What Makes a Peacock Special
narration: The male peacock has bright blue and green feathers that look like shimmering jewels.
He can spread his feathers wide to show off a giant, beautiful fan.
The female bird is called a peahen, and she has soft brown feathers.

scenes.title: Seeing a Peacock
narration: Peacocks love to live in forests and near villages across India.
In the morning, they walk on the ground to look for tasty seeds and snacks.
When they hear thunder, they call out and dance in the rain.

scenes.title: Let's Remember
narration: The peacock is our national bird because it is graceful and bold.
We protect them so they can keep our forests beautiful.
Think about it: If you were a peacock, what would you do when the rain starts?

scenes.title: Spotting the Big Cat
narration: Have you seen a big cat with orange fur and black stripes?
That is the Royal Bengal Tiger, India's national animal.
Do you know why we chose this amazing animal?

scenes.title: Why the Tiger Rules
narration: The tiger stands for strength, courage, and power.
It is a very fast and clever hunter in the jungle.
Tigers live in the deep forests all across India.

scenes.title: Tiger Features
narration: Every tiger has its own special pattern of black stripes.
Just like your fingerprints, no two tigers are the same.
They use their stripes to hide in the tall grass.

scenes.title: Keeping Tigers Safe
narration: We must protect our tigers and their forest homes.
They are a special part of India's natural beauty.
If you could visit a forest, would you look for a tiger?

scenes.title: The Big Celebration
narration: Have you seen flags waving on houses every August 15th?
That is because it is India's special birthday!
Do you know why we celebrate this day?

scenes.title: Learning Our History
narration: Long ago, India was ruled by the British.
Many brave leaders fought hard for our freedom.
On August 15, 1947, India became a free country.

scenes.title: How We Celebrate
narration: The Prime Minister hoists the flag at the Red Fort.
We sing our beautiful national anthem together.
Children fly colorful kites in the bright blue sky.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Freedom
narration: We celebrate freedom every August 15th.
It reminds us to love our country always.
How will you celebrate Independence Day this year?

scenes.title: Have you seen this flower?
narration: Have you seen a pretty pink flower floating on a pond?
It is called a lotus, and it is very special to India.
Do you know why we call it our national flower?

scenes.title: Learning about the lotus
narration: The lotus grows in mud at the bottom of ponds.
Its long stem pushes up through the water.
Then, a big, beautiful flower blooms in the sun.
Even in muddy water, it stays clean and lovely.

scenes.title: Why it is special
narration: Think of a pond in a park near your house.
If you see a lotus, remember it stands for beauty.
It also stands for staying good even when things are tough.

scenes.title: Time to remember
narration: The lotus is India's national flower.
It grows in water and stays clean and bright.
Can you draw a beautiful lotus flower today?

scenes.title: Hearing the Anthem
narration: Have you heard this music at your school assembly?
It is our national anthem called Jana Gana Mana.
We stand up straight to show our love for India.

scenes.title: Learning About It
narration: Rabindranath Tagore wrote these special words long ago.
The song talks about our mountains and rivers.
It celebrates all the people living in our country.

scenes.title: Showing Respect
narration: We stay very quiet when the music plays.
We do not talk or move around.
This tells everyone we respect our flag and land.

scenes.title: Time to Remember
narration: Jana Gana Mana makes us feel like one big family.
It is a song that belongs to every Indian.
Can you name one place where you hear our anthem?

scenes.title: The Sweet Summer Surprise
narration: Have you ever eaten a juicy, yellow fruit during the hot summer break?
It tastes so sweet and smells delicious when you walk through the market.
Do you know that this special fruit is the national fruit of India?

scenes.title: Why the Mango is King
narration: The mango is called the King of Fruits because it is loved by everyone.
It grows on big, shady trees in many parts of our country.
Farmers work hard to bring these tasty fruits to our homes.
They need lots of warm sun and rain to grow big and juicy.

scenes.title: A Tasty Indian Treat
narration: Think of a delicious glass of cool mango lassi on a hot day.
Or sweet mango pulp served with hot, fluffy puris at lunch.
India grows many kinds of mangoes, like the sweet Alphonso from Maharashtra.

scenes.title: Recap and Fun Question
narration: So, the mango is our national fruit and it loves the summer sun.
It grows on trees and makes our summers very tasty and sweet.
Think about it: What is your favorite way to eat a mango?

scenes.title: A Special October Morning
narration: Have you seen our schools closed on October second?
It is a national holiday called Gandhi Jayanti.
Do you know who we are remembering today?

scenes.title: The Father of Our Nation
narration: We celebrate Mahatma Gandhi, the father of our nation.
He was a very kind and brave leader.
He taught everyone to follow the path of truth.
He believed in peace and non-violence.

scenes.title: Learning From His Life
narration: Gandhi ji loved wearing simple homespun cloth called Khadi.
He walked long distances to help his people.
He always kept his surroundings very clean.

scenes.title: Remembering His Great Lessons
narration: We honor him by being kind and helpful.
We also help clean our neighborhoods today.
Think about it: how can you be helpful today?

scenes.title: A Special Day at School
narration: Have you seen your teacher smiling extra wide on September fifth?
That is because it is Teachers Day in India!
Do you know why we celebrate this day every year?

scenes.title: Who Was Dr. Radhakrishnan
narration: We celebrate to honor a very wise teacher named Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.
He was a great scholar and the second President of India.
He believed that teachers are the most important people in our country.

scenes.title: Celebrating Our Teachers
narration: On this day, students often give cards or flowers to say thank you.
Some students even perform dances or sing songs for their teachers.
It is a time to show how much we appreciate their help.

scenes.title: Remembering the Lesson
narration: Teachers Day honors Dr. Radhakrishnan and all our wonderful teachers.
It is a day to say thank you for all the things we learn.
What kind thing will you do for your teacher this year?

scenes.title: A Special Day at School
narration: Have you noticed your teachers acting extra silly and fun at school today?
It is because today is a very special celebration called Children's Day!
Do you know why we have this day just for kids like you?

scenes.title: Remembering Chacha Nehru
narration: Long ago, India had a leader named Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru.
He loved children very much and was fondly called Chacha Nehru.
His birthday is on November 14th, which we celebrate as Children's Day.

scenes.title: Celebrating With Love
narration: On this day, we remember that every child is precious and important.
Schools often hold games, dances, and fun programs for everyone.
It is a day to celebrate your happiness, your dreams, and your future.

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: Children's Day is on November 14th to honor Chacha Nehru's love.
We celebrate the joy and wonder that you bring to the world.
Think about it: What is one thing you love to do that makes you happy?

scenes.title: A Special Day at School
narration: Have you seen flags flying high at school in January?
That is because we celebrate Republic Day on January 26th.
Do you wonder why this day is so special for India?

scenes.title: The Rule Book of India
narration: A long time ago, India made a big book of rules.
These rules help everyone in our country live together happily.
This special book is called the Constitution of India.
It started on January 26th, 1950.

scenes.title: Celebrating With a Parade
narration: In Delhi, we have a very grand parade.
Soldiers march proudly down the road.
Colorful floats show different states from all over India.
The President of India salutes the flag.

scenes.title: Celebrating Together
narration: Republic Day reminds us that we are all one big family.
We feel proud and happy to be Indians.
Think about it, how will you celebrate with your friends this year?

scenes.title: Looking at Nature
narration: Look outside at the green trees and blue sky.
Have you ever wondered how we keep our Earth happy?
There is a special day just for our planet.

scenes.title: What is Environment Day?
narration: It is called World Environment Day.
We celebrate it every year on June 5th.
It reminds us to take care of our home.
The environment is everything around us like air and water.

scenes.title: Doing Our Part
narration: Rohan plants a small sapling in his garden.
He waters it carefully with his little can.
He also picks up litter to keep the park clean.
Small acts make the Earth very happy.

scenes.title: Time to Recap
narration: World Environment Day is on June 5th.
We help nature by planting trees and not littering.
Think about it: What will you plant today?
